summary: Revenue was $10.78m versus the $12.67m-$13.13m bar, while debt rose from the last-known $80m to $105m at quarter-end and $120m by August 3; cash fell to $4.5m, working capital was negative $105.7m, and derivatives lost $4.56m. Post-quarter SOL/share growth to 0.0754 and adequate collateral coverage mitigate the downside, but the priced-in treasury accretion does not offset the newly disclosed leverage and liquidity deterioration.
